text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 14-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about 5 hours a week. CRM updates stopped being a Friday-night chore.

2. Notes got better, not just faster. Next steps and objections were captured consistently, which made pipeline reviews far more useful.

3. Consent matters. Early on, two customers hesitated. A quick heads-up before every call fixed it.

4. Adoption followed trust. Reps who reviewed summaries for the first two weeks kept using the tool. Those who didn't, dropped off.

5. Managers coached from real conversations instead of recollections.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It gave reps more time to use it.

Is your team piloting something similar? What surprised you?
